description: The line plot illustrates the model's evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) under different sparsity settings applied to the Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components at varying ratios of activated parameters. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio, which is a percentage ranging from 25% to 100%, with tick labels at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. The y-axis measures the Eval PPL, with values ranging from approximately 11.5 to 14.0, and tick labels at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, and 13.0. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different model configuration. The dashed line with square markers represents the Transformer model, which maintains a relatively constant Eval PPL across the range of activated parameters. The solid line with square markers, labeled "Only MoHD FFN," shows a slight increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameters ratio decreases. The solid line with circle markers, labeled "Only MoHD ATTN," exhibits a more significant increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameters ratio decreases. The line with cross markers, labeled "MoHD ATTN + MLP," shows a steep increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameters ratio decreases, indicating a higher sensitivity to sparsity in this configuration.
